scope: Computer Control Phase 9C2A OS-owned native macOS Dock read-only semantic observation
platform: macOS Dock system chrome via native Accessibility

safetyBoundary.addressing: global OS-owned Dock process resolved by backend-private bundle identity com.apple.dock; public API accepts no process or application identifier
safetyBoundary.cleanup: physical harness stops only its own temporary Computer Control runtime and removes its temporary compiled independent oracle

expectedCoverage: dock.observe capability reports IMPLEMENTED through runtimeInfo before physical promotion
public dock.observe is global and accepts no parameters
reference host exposes exactly one running OS Dock process before product observation
public dock.observe returns OBSERVED with a non-empty semantic Dock item list on the reference host
every public item contains only kind, title, running and status
public kind is canonicalized to application, folder, trash, separator or other
at least one application item, exactly one trash item and at least one separator item are observed
public result exposes no AX roles/subroles, action names, bundle identity, native handles, PID, URLs or coordinates
independent native system-chrome oracle agrees exactly with public Dock item order, canonical kind and visible title
repeated observation still exposes the core application/trash/separator topology
observation method and backend strategy identify the OS-owned native AX Dock observation path
no Dock item is invoked and no UI mutation is performed
